meta.notes: Pins F2 (dryer_monitor.py:550-600,1745-1760), the dryer side of the washer 2026-08-19 stale-restore-announce incident (washer_monitor.py:991-1017, 3607-3634). Boot restores Running from the durable store only (entity_state is null - HA restarted, not just AD): start_time 3h ago, last_high_energy_at 170min ago (outside restore_corroboration_window_minutes=10) and live power reads 0W - uncorroborated. MUST NOT announce; MUST set hypothesis=true and schedule a one-shot RECONCILE (spec 8). INTEGRATION-TIME REVISION: originally this tape also fed two live power=0W samples so RECONCILE's power-history window (spec 8, DryerPolicy.g_reconcilable) would have data to conclude from - verified against the real engine, that back-fires: ANY live power sample <= stop_w reaching a RUNNING+hypothesis cycle is caught by the ordinary PowerEndDetector pipeline first (RUNNING->ENDING via a_enter_ending_power), and ENDING has no RECONCILE row in TABLE - the scheduled RECONCILE then no-ops as an unlisted (ENDING, RECONCILE) pair. Confirmed engine behavior (not this tape's call to fix): a hypothesis-Running cycle resolved via that ordinary low-power path never clears hypothesis at all (only a_track_power_high/a_resume_from_pause/a_reconcile call ctx.clear_hypothesis()) - worth the engine owner's attention, flagged in the integration report rather than patched here. This tape now pins the directly reachable half instead: with NO live signal at all before the one-shot RECONCILE fires (~60s), spec 8's 'absent power history is NEVER taken as off' holds exactly - g_reconcilable sees an empty window and refuses to conclude, so the cycle stays Running/hypothesis=true, safely, rather than silently guessing Off/Unemptied. NOTE: this tape does not exercise the companion 'door-open edge in history -> route EMPTIED silently' branch of spec 8, nor the 'history is populated and quietly concludes' branch - both require a live signal that (per the finding above) would currently pre-empt RECONCILE before it can run; a fixture for those needs either an engine-side fix or a harness seam that populates get_history without also firing the live detector pipeline, neither of which is this integration pass's call to make.
